# SW2URDF {{RELEASE_DATE}} Update / 更新版

## English

### What changed

- Migrate legacy export configurations after reviewing component, frame, and axis references. The original configuration is retained.
- Fix Link count/hierarchy edits, multi-selection clearing Joint names, Mimic references after Joint renaming, and inertia values after changing a Link frame.
- Respect SolidWorks mass, COM, and inertia overrides. Measured-mass calibration uses consistent values for the property page, equivalent inertia cuboid, and exported models.
- Select all four outputs by default; toggling a target no longer rebuilds the entire page. Improve display scaling and reduce repeated repaint work.
- Keep successful targets when another target fails, with separate results and directories. Shared model/inertia errors still stop export.
- Improve large-mesh MJCF export and official MuJoCo validation without lossy inertia roundtrips. Keep the consistent, responsive export progress window.
- Restore export settings, report actual STL settings, and retain inertia diagnostic CSV files after failures.

### Installation and documentation

Close every SolidWorks process, run the x64 installer as administrator, and restart SolidWorks.
Back up production assemblies before upgrading; review migrated references before saving.
See the [English handbook](https://osrbot.github.io/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/en/) and [Wiki](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/wiki).

### Tested scope and remaining limits

- Published on 2026-09-07 using the unchanged installer built on 2026-09-06. Documentation updates do not replace or rebuild the tested binary.
- Installed payload verified against all 249 provenance entries. In SolidWorks 2023 SP1.0, the test assembly completed ROS1, ROS2, OpenUSD, and MJCF export: 125 files, about 326.4 MiB, in 5 minutes 1 second.
- Plug-in regression tests: 889 passed. Core tests: 82 passed. Independent output verification: 131 checks passed, including relocated USD dependencies and official MuJoCo XML/MJB loading and one-step checks.
- Initial preview still took about 2 minutes 8 seconds, and pre-export inertia validation about 2 minutes 25 seconds on that assembly. These delays are not claimed fixed; no lazy-loading/cache or experimental preselection changes are included.
- This is not blanket validation of all SW versions, DPI settings, Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab, ROS/Gazebo, controllers, or long-running simulations. The installer is not Authenticode-signed.
- Detailed [installed-build evidence](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/blob/master/docs/reviews/2026-09-06-installed-fc88a14-retest.md) and [performance investigation](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/blob/master/docs/reviews/2026-09-06-preview-latency-investigation.md) distinguish the shipped build from unshipped experiments.

## 简体中文

### 修改内容

- 旧配置可以在核对组件、坐标系和轴后迁移，原配置保留。
- 修复 Link 数量和层级修改、多选清空 Joint 名称、Joint 重命名后的 Mimic 引用，以及更改 Link 坐标系后的惯性转换问题。
- 支持 SolidWorks 覆盖质量、质心和惯性矩。实测质量校准后，属性页、等效惯性长方体和导出模型使用一致的数值。
- 四个输出目标默认勾选；勾选或取消不再重建整个页面。改善显示缩放，减少重复重绘。
- 单个目标失败时保留其他成功目标，分别显示结果和目录；共享模型或惯性错误仍会阻止导出。
- 改进大网格 MJCF 导出和官方 MuJoCo 校验，避免有损惯性往返转换；保留统一、流畅的导出进度窗口。
- 恢复导出设置、报告 SW 实际采用的 STL 参数，并在惯性校验失败后保留诊断 CSV。

### 安装与文档

关闭所有 SolidWorks 进程，以管理员身份安装 x64 安装包，再重新启动 SolidWorks。
升级前备份生产装配体，迁移后核对引用再保存。
使用说明见[中文手册](https://osrbot.github.io/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/)和 [Wiki](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/wiki/Home-zh-CN)。

### 测试范围与已知限制

- 本版于 2026-09-07 发布，沿用 2026-09-06 构建的原安装包；文档更新不会替换或重新构建已经实测的二进制。
- 已安装的 249 个文件与构建记录核验一致。SolidWorks 2023 SP1.0 中，测试装配体四目标全部导出成功：125 个文件，约 326.4 MiB，用时 5 分 1 秒。
- 插件回归测试 889 项、Core 测试 82 项通过；独立输出检查 131 项通过，包括移动目录后的 USD 引用，以及官方 MuJoCo 的 XML/MJB 加载和单步检查。
- 该装配体首次预览仍约需 2 分 8 秒，导出前惯性校验约需 2 分 25 秒。本版不宣称已解决这些等待，也未加入按需加载、缓存或试验性预选择优化。
- 不代表全部 SW 版本、DPI、Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab、ROS/Gazebo、控制器或长时间仿真均已验证。安装包未做 Authenticode 签名。
- [安装实测记录](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/blob/master/docs/reviews/2026-09-06-installed-fc88a14-retest.md)与[性能排查记录](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/blob/master/docs/reviews/2026-09-06-preview-latency-investigation.md)明确区分发布代码和未采用的实验。
